Package org.geysermc.paletter

Class Palette

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.Palette
public final class Palette extends Object
Everything a Bedrock client of one version needs to know about items and blocks: vanilla data plus a stack of PaletteLayers, compiled. Immutable and thread safe; share it between all sessions it applies to.

Sending it to a client: 


 palette.applyTo(session.getCodecHelper());     // item and block definitions for the codec
 palette.applyTo(startGamePacket);              // block properties and the block network id mode
 session.sendPacket(palette.itemComponentPacket());
 session.sendPacket(palette.creativeContentPacket());
Translating content uses handles, version independent and interned objects (BedrockBlockState, BedrockItemVariant): block(NbtMap) and item(String, int) find them once, then runtimeId(BedrockBlockState) and block(BedrockBlockState) for blocks, item(BedrockItemVariant) for items. encode(org.geysermc.paletter.item.BedrockItemStack) and decode(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData) translate whole stacks at the protocol boundary. They are field reads and array lookups that do not allocate. The ids behind the handles are not API.
Since:
1.0.0

    • blockOf

      public @Nullable RegisteredBlockState blockOf(@NonNull BedrockItemVariant variant)
      The block an item variant is sent with in this palette's version, in its default state: Paletter alone decides it, see ItemRegistry.blockOf(org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockItemVariant). A stack may carry a block state of its own, see encode(org.geysermc.paletter.item.BedrockItemStack). Works for every variant: known, registered with PaletteLayer.Builder#variant, of a custom block item, or one Paletter has never heard of (the block of its item). RegisteredBlockState.key() is the block as a key.
      Returns:
      the block, or null if the item is not a block item (or does not exist in this version and has no fallback)
      Since:
      1.0.0

    • isFallback

      public boolean isFallback(@NonNull BedrockItemVariant variant)
      Whether this palette sends an item variant as another item, see fallbackOf(org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockItemVariant). A lookup, not a debugging aid: cheap for every item of a version.
      Returns:
      true if the variant is replaced by a fallback; false if it is sent as itself, or nothing is sent for it
      Since:
      1.0.0

    • fallbackOf

      public @Nullable BedrockItemVariant fallbackOf(@NonNull BedrockItemVariant variant)
      The item variant this palette sends in place of a variant its version lacks (or that a forced Fallbacks entry replaces), or the default fallback (minecraft:unknown). Customised by Fallbacks of the Paletter; the aux is the one of the fallback's variant, else the replaced variant's.
      Returns:
      the replacement, or null if the variant is sent as itself (or not at all: no fallback, see encode(org.geysermc.paletter.item.BedrockItemStack))
      Since:
      1.0.0

    • blockKeyOf

      public @Nullable BedrockBlockState blockKeyOf(@NonNull BedrockItemVariant variant)
      The version independent key of blockOf(org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockItemVariant): the block state an item variant is sent with, as a BedrockBlockState, for every kind of variant (vanilla, extra, custom block items, fallbacks). Unlike Paletter.blockOf(org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockItemVariant), which knows the vanilla variants of the newest data only, this follows the palette: the fallback's block in an old version, the custom block of a layer. runtimeId(BedrockBlockState) gives its runtime id here.
      Returns:
      the block's key, or null if the item is not a block item here (or the state has no key: a vanilla state that is not in the newest bundled data)
      Since:
      1.0.0

    • encode

      public @NonNull org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData encode(@NonNull BedrockItemStack stack)
      Encodes a stack for this palette's version: the item with the aux value, count and NBT, and the block the stack places (its own block state if it has one and the item places blocks, else the item's default block). An item this version does not have is replaced according to the fallback policy.
      Returns:
      the item data, or ItemData.AIR if there is no item at all (not in this version, no fallback, or not in this palette)
      Since:
      1.0.0

    • decode

      public @Nullable BedrockItemStack decode(@NonNull org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData data)
      Decodes a stack the client sent. The block state is set only if the stack's block differs from the item's default block. The stack of a fallback shared by several variants, or of an item that is not a variant of the newest version, is not recognized.
      Returns:
      the stack, or null for air or an item this palette cannot identify
      Since:
      1.0.0
